messages.subject: Deducer issues
parts:
Hi Ian,

Great tool. I tried it with a small data set and got great results.
Now with a slightly larger data set, I'm running into problems. Can
you help.

I have posted the data set to google doc. It can be obtained here

https://spreadsheets.google.com/pub?key=0At6cBzS-xPyrdEhTblpkdjJ1Nm84NHJOYTNYOC1fRkE&hl=en&output=html

JGR -v1.7-1
R 2.11.1
Deducer 0.4-0

Problem 1
Simple scatter plot (Geom Point) of sum30avg (x) and LineName(y) I
cannot seem to select jitter in the position setting.

Problem 2
When I try to add geom Crossbar, I cannot select 'summary' in the drop
down menu.

Thanks,
Vivek

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Deducer issues
parts:
Hi Vivek,

That is a bug on some Mac OS X machines. It has been fixed in the
development version on rforge.net. You can also work around it by
going to Preferences>Deducer, and disabling native chooser look and
feel. Then restart JGR.

ian
